gaps.what: neo-gothic church windows: a tall arched tracery window with a rose head in the centre axis and a narrower arched window to the left
a pointed stone portal with columns and a fanlight round the main door, a second arched door on the left
stone pinnacles and buttress strips at the gable corners, a brick corbel frieze along the gable slopes

notes: A church front, not a house; a tree trunk covers the right third, so the axes cannot all be counted.
